About.bioTitle: I build software with curiosity, care, and purpose.
About.bio: I'm Luis Sebastián Díaz, a fifth-semester Software Engineering student in Pasto. I enjoy turning real needs into clear, functional digital products, from web interfaces to ESP32-connected solutions. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn, refine the details, and build technology that is genuinely useful to people.

Projects.subtitle: Systems built with a focus on performance, distributed architectures, integrated hardware and type safety.
Projects.viewSourceCode: View source code for {title} on GitHub

descriptions.ecoplaza-iot-desktop: Comprehensive solid waste weighing and traceability system for collection centers. Direct serial connection with ESP32 microcontrollers and ultrasonic sensors, real-time synchronization and highly resilient local persistence.
descriptions.visual-trace-mobile: Mobile application for visual auditing, field inspection and data capture. Designed with an offline-first architecture featuring asynchronous synchronization, strict schema validation and smooth rendering.
descriptions.ridewake-platform: Reactive platform for geolocation, trajectory analysis and mobility assistance alerts. Continuous tracking and dispatch algorithms optimized for battery efficiency and low power consumption.
descriptions.lullaby-3d-game: Interactive 3D video game developed through engineering collaboration. Implementation of decoupled render loop, dynamic 3D physics, ambient shaders and finite state machine.
